title: 第9章 再遇王远滕第10章 要住山上 88xiaoshuo net
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 拳法上选了九灵元皇拳，至于选刀还是剑，枪，郑元认为还是觉得修炼剑道好。
剑有兵中之王的称呼，而且随身携带优雅。
所以有一部凌天剑诀让郑元一眼就相中了，修炼到最高境界还能御剑飞行，这绝对是太拉风了。
身法则是选了真灵九变，郑元自然不知道，这些功法即使是在上界也都是顶级功法。
郑元手一点，挑选好的功法全部都进入了识海里。
王家！
“龙少，你怎么样了？那个郑元太狠了，居然把你打成这样，现在咱们该怎么办啊？”
王艳看着鼻青脸肿的龙啸天露出一脸关心之意。
当然心里暗暗骂着这个废物东西，开脉三层修为居然连一个开脉一层修为的郑元都打不过。
明显在宗门里就是一个不学无术的纨绔公子哥。
不过自己还要依靠龙啸天进入红云宗，所以王艳脸上露出了一副含情脉脉之意。
其实王艳还真冤枉了龙啸天，因为郑元和瑶池女帝双修同样受益良多，身体里还有一丝大道之韵，九阳之体更是肉身强悍。
龙啸天露出一脸狰狞面目，今天丢大人了。
虽然郑元已经手下留情了，但自己什么时候受过如此奇耻大辱。
“宝贝，我这就回宗去找我师兄，他可是开脉九层修为，一定能替我报仇雪恨。”
龙啸天眼睛里闪过一丝阴毒之色，这仇一定要报。
王艳听到这话突然眼睛一亮，更是抓住了龙啸天的手。
“龙少，你能不能顺便给我说下进入宗门的事？”
宗门无论是功法还是修炼资源，名师指点，都比家族要强百倍。
不过宗门招收徒弟非常严格，像王艳这种资质的人根本就进不去。
等自己进入宗门就把这个废物给甩了。
“好说，好说，那就看宝贝你的表现了？”
龙啸天看到王艳的低胸装不禁血气上涌，又大又白，诱人无比，一只大手忍不住伸了过去。
“讨厌啦，龙少你的伤还没有好，能不能行啊？”
王艳以前对这个龙啸天还感觉不错，但今天看到郑元威武霸气的样子，心里不禁有些抵触情绪了，一双玉手更是抵在了龙啸天的胸前。
嘶！
龙啸天因为动作幅度大了些牵动了伤口，嘴里发出一声叫唤，不过此时精虫上脑，哪里还顾得上伤口。
“宝贝，爷行不行试一下你不就知道了？”
啊！
王艳嘴里发出一声惊呼，那就是衣服被龙啸天一把扯开了。
欲迎还拒的样子更是让龙啸天心里痒痒的。
第二天早上，郑元早早起来了，十万大山也是自己必须要去的，因为爹的旧伤想要彻底治好还需要一味药草，灵叶芝，那也是炼制蕴灵丹的主药。
“哥，我也要和你一起上山去采药。”
小妹郑萱搂着郑元的胳膊央求着，虽然已经是大姑娘了，但童心未泯。
郑元一听这话赶紧婉言拒绝了，自己要和城主女儿加深感情，有这么一个灯泡在旁边还怎么加深。
当然也不能直接说出来，郑元借着爹娘的病情还没有完全康复，还需要有人照顾的理由。
“那哥你给我抓只玉凤兔回来玩。”
郑萱撅着嘴，当然也知道爹娘病刚好需要照顾。
“没问题，我走了啊。”
content_en:
In terms of boxing, he chose Jiuling Yuanhuang Fist. As for whether to choose a sword or a sword or a spear, Zheng Yuan thought it was better to practice swordsmanship.
The sword is called the king of weapons and is carried elegantly.
Therefore, there is a Lingtian Sword Art that Zheng Yuan fell in love with at a glance. After practicing to the highest level, he can still fly with the sword. This is absolutely amazing.
The body method is to choose the Nine Transformations of True Spirit. Naturally, Zheng Yuan does not know that these skills are top-notch skills even in the upper world.
Zheng Yuan moved a little bit, and all the selected exercises entered the sea of ​​consciousness.
…
Wang family!
"Master Long, how are you? That Zheng Yuan was so cruel that he beat you like this. What should we do now?"
Wang Yan looked at Long Xiaotian, who had a bruised nose and swollen face, with a look of concern.
Of course, he was secretly cursing this trash in his heart. He couldn't even beat Zheng Yuan, who was at the third level of Kai Mai.
It is obvious that he is an ignorant and ignorant playboy in the sect.
However, he still had to rely on Long Xiaotian to enter the Hongyun Sect, so Wang Yan had a look of affection on her face.
In fact, Wang Yan really wronged Long Xiaotian, because Zheng Yuan and the Yaochi Empress also benefited a lot from their dual cultivation. There is still a trace of the charm of the Dao in their bodies, and the Nine Yang Body is even more physically powerful.
Long Xiaotian showed a ferocious face, he was embarrassed today.
Although Zheng Yuan has been merciful, when did he ever suffer such humiliation?
"Baby, I'm going back to the sect to find my senior brother. He has a ninth-level cultivation level, and he will definitely be able to avenge me."
A sinister look flashed in Long Xiaotian's eyes, this revenge must be avenged.
Wang Yan's eyes suddenly lit up when she heard this, and she grabbed Long Xiaotian's hand.
"Master Long, can you tell me about joining the sect by the way?"
The sect is a hundred times stronger than the family in terms of skills, cultivation resources, and guidance from famous teachers.
However, the sect is very strict in recruiting apprentices, and people with Wang Yan's qualifications simply cannot get in.
When he enters the sect, he will get rid of this waste.
"Easy to say, easy to say, then it depends on your performance, honey?"
Long Xiaotian couldn't help but get excited when he saw Wang Yan's low-cut dress. It was big, white, and extremely alluring, and he couldn't help but stretch out a big hand.
"I hate it. Mr. Long, your injury hasn't healed yet. Can you do it?"
Wang Yan had a good impression of Long Xiaotian before, but today when she saw Zheng Yuan's mighty and domineering appearance, she couldn't help feeling a little resentful, and a pair of jade hands pressed against Long Xiaotian's chest.
hiss!
Long Xiaotian let out a cry because his wounds were affected by his excessive movements, but at this moment, his sperm was on his head and he couldn't care about the wounds.
"Baby, can you try it and you will know?"
Ah!
Wang Yan let out a exclamation, that is, her clothes were ripped off by Long Xiaotian.
The look of wanting to welcome but refusing made Long Xiaotian feel itchy in his heart.
…
The next morning, Zheng Yuan got up early. He had to go to Shiwandashan, because to completely cure his father's old injury, he needed a herb, Ganoderma lucidum, which is also the main medicine for refining the Spirit-enhancing Pill.
"Brother, I also want to go up the mountain with you to collect herbs."
The younger sister Zheng Xuan hugged Zheng Yuan's arm and begged. Although she was already a big girl, her childlike innocence remained.
When Zheng Yuan heard this, he quickly declined politely. He wanted to deepen his relationship with the city lord's daughter, how could he deepen it with such a light bulb beside him.
Of course, he couldn't say it directly. Zheng Yuan took advantage of the fact that his parents' condition had not fully recovered and they still needed someone to take care of them.
"Brother, please catch me a jade phoenix rabbit and bring it back to play with."
Zheng Xuan pouted, knowing that her parents were ill and needed care.
"No problem, I'm leaving."
